description: Fetch per-publisher performance for the brand's programme at Admitad (advertiser) — clicks, conversions, gross sale, and commission, by date. Use this when the user asks "how is each publisher performing on Admitad (advertiser)?", "show me the top-earning partners last month", or wants the per-publisher rollup. Returns ProgrammePerformanceRow records; pair with list_media_partners to discover publisher ids and list_transactions for transaction-level drill-down.
name: affiliate_admitad-advertiser_get_programme_performance
